newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken makes no comment on Stadshypote.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken makes no comment on Stadshypote.

text.p: One of Sweden's big four banks, Nordbanken, on Tuesday declined to comment on a newspaper report that it had made a preliminary bid for part of mortgage bank Stadhypotek.
"We cannot confirm this and cannot deny it .. .we have no intention of commenting. This is a process being driven by the Finance Department," bank spokesman Peter Fosblad told Reuters.
Business daily Finans Tidningen reported on Tuesday that Nordbanken had put in a note of interest in buying the state's share in Stadshypotek.
The government announced last month that it intended to sell its 34 percent stake in Stadshypotek by controlled auction with the aim of getting the best possible price.
